types.description: Provisional generic maintained/latching emergency-stop operator with one NC contact; manual reset releases the latch. No safety performance claim.

connectionCoverage.notes: Reviewed generic interface: Single NC pair 11/12, closed in the released/reset state and open while the operator is latched; both ends are required. Maintained/latching behavior is descriptive, not simulated. Optional: none in this interface. Unmodeled: redundant channels, monitoring, illumination, extra contacts and bonding. Select hardware and add applicable ratings; no safety category, stop category or manufacturer pinout is established.
